description: This Java class defines an immutable mapper that converts a BsonArray to a JsonArray, providing functionality to revise JSON key names via a configurable function.

classes.name: BsonArrayToJsonObjectMapper
classes.description: An immutable mapper class that transforms BsonArray instances into JsonArray instances, with optional key revision.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BsonArrayToJsonObjectMapper with a specified JSON key name reviser function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs the conversion of a BsonArray to a JsonArray, applying key revisions as needed.
